tasks.name: 创建博客模型
tasks.description: 创建 Blog 模型用于存储博客文章信息。在 app/models/ 目录下创建 blog.py，包含字段: id, title, content, image_url, created_at。

tasks.name: 创建图片上传功能
tasks.description: 实现图片上传功能。在 app/utils/ 下创建 image_upload.py，包含上传图片到服务器的逻辑，并支持文件类型验证。

tasks.name: 创建博客API
tasks.description: 创建博客文章的 CRUD API 路由。在 app/routes/ 下创建 blogs.py，包含增删改查接口，并支持图片上传功能。

tasks.name: 创建博客前端页面
tasks.description: 创建博客管理的前端页面。在 templates/ 下创建 blogs.html，包含博客文章的创建表单、图片上传功能和文章列表展示。

tasks.name: 设置静态文件支持
tasks.description: 配置静态文件支持以存储上传的图片。在项目的 settings 文件中添加静态文件路径，并确保前端可以访问上传的图片。

T1.implementation_approach: Define a Blog model with fields like title, content, author, and timestamps using an ORM such as Django ORM or SQLAlchemy.
T1.notes: Ensure proper field validation and indexing for efficient querying.

T2.implementation_approach: Implement an image upload feature using a library like Pillow for validation and store images in a media directory or cloud storage.
T2.notes: Set file size and format restrictions to ensure security and performance.

T3.implementation_approach: Create RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on the Blog model using a framework like Django REST Framework or Flask.
T3.notes: Include authentication and pagination for secure and scalable access.

T4.implementation_approach: Develop a frontend using a framework like React or Vue.js to display blogs, with forms for creating and editing posts.
T4.notes: Ensure responsive design and integrate API calls for dynamic content.

T5.implementation_approach: Configure the web server or framework to serve static files like CSS, JS, and images, using tools like Django's static files setup or Flask's send_from_directory.
T5.notes: Use caching and compression for better performance.
